page.layout: Two blocks: one page of running text in a single column; a marginal note in the right margin beside the verse heading area ("Lectio 6").

main_text.p: tarijs, in illis suis cœnobijs exponeret, & nequaquam operâ suam Ecclesiæ, si quan do fideli illorum ministerio ei opus esset, denegarent.

Si qui autem uel tædio & fastidio com munium in uita humana & Repub. æ- rumnarum & difficultatum, uel uanisi- ma meritorum uitæ monachalis fiducia, uel deniq; uentris ocijq; studio moti,su- is desertis, nemorum latebras & cœno- biorum fecerunt captauerunt, eos Timo- nis μισανθρώπως, & agreftis cuiusdam Ono- phrij (quem fingunt totos 60 annos ho- minem alium non confpicatum fuisse) imitatores & uerè feruû pecus esse, quis dubitet? Vel enim ὑπερόπτης, uel uana super- stitio, eos ad istud nunquam à Deo præ- ceptum uitæ genus impellit: quibus de caufsis digni sunt, qui uelut καθαρμάτα, & humani generis purgamenta, è societate hominum submoueantur, & reatus sui fi- gna, rasum uerticem, cucullam, restim, & alia desertionis suæ symbola portent.
main_text.head: VERSVS VI.

p.i: Et præparauit Iehouah Deus cucurbi- tam, quæ ascendit super Ionam, ut esset um- bra

page.notes: Marginal note right of verse: "Lectio 6." (side="right", at the verse heading line). Doubtful readings: "tarijs" (line start, likely "tarijs" = "tarijs" from "cœnobijs"?), "captauerunt" and "fecerunt" in "fecerunt/captauerunt" seem to read "fecerunt captauerunt" as printed "fecessus captauerunt" — rendered as printed "fecefsus"; Greek words transcribed approximately from the scan (μισανθρώπως, ὑπερόπτης, καθαρμάτα), not certain letter-by-letter. "Ono-phrij" hyphenation kept as printed. Show-through and page edges omitted.
